summary: Sandbach United are gearing up for an exciting 2026/27 season with just one week until kick-off, welcoming several new signings and a returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers are actively seeking sponsorship opportunities across their three new kits as they chase promotion. Coming off a narrow defeat to St Helens in a closely contested friendly, the team will be looking to put that behind them and start the campaign strong.
